messages:
auditor_chloe: Hi team — auditor request: we need a mapped evidence package tying incident INCT-2026-05 to KMS key usage, RBAC changes, and post-incident remediation. Specifically: timeline, CloudTrail/KMS proof of decrypt/encrypt, RBAC delta (who changed roles), and chain-of-custody for exported artifacts. Can you confirm what you can provide and ETA?

samir_security: We can provide all of that. ETA for initial package: EOD tomorrow. Will contain: CloudTrail slice, KMS Grant/Use events, RBAC change commits + k8s rolebinding diffs, signed manifest, and hashes.

auditor_chloe: EOD tomorrow sounds fine. For chain-of-custody we need verifiable signatures and a short narrative of who handled each artifact. Also preserve original object timestamps.

alex_ops: I'll extract CloudTrail & KMS logs for the incident window (2026-05-14T02:03:00Z to 2026-05-14T03:30:00Z). Plan: run an export job to S3 (private bucket), generate SHA256 for each file, sign the SHA256 sum with my GPG key. Example commands I'll run: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-05-14T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-05-14T04:00:00Z --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt > ct-window.json
sha256sum ct-window.json > ct-window.sha256
cat ct-window.sha256 | gpg --default-key 0xA1B2C3D4 --sign > ct-window.sha256.sig
```
I'll upload artifacts to s3://redwood-audit-exports/inct-2026-05/ and create a presigned link for the auditor.

maya_oncall: For RBAC diffs: I captured the k8s-api audit logs and the GitHub repo history for infra/roles. Quick snippet of the git commands I'll include: 
```
git --no-pager log --pretty=oneline --since="2026-05-13" --until="2026-05-15" -- infra/roles/ | sed -n '1,50p' > rbac-commits.txt
git diff <old_sha> <new_sha> -- infra/roles/rolebindings.yaml > rolebinding-diff.patch
```
I'll also export k8s audit events for the specific namespace (inference-prod).

security-bot: Incident INCT-2026-05 status updated to "evidence_export_in_progress" by @alex_ops — ticket #INC-8942.

auditor_chloe: We prefer access proofs from KMS logs that show keyId and callerIdentity. Can you include the KMS event payloads? Also provide the key rotation history for the involved CMKs (any rotation within 90 days).

samir_security: Yes. We'll include raw CloudTrail KMS events and a summarized CSV that maps eventId -> keyId -> principal -> operation (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey). We'll also include a small script that verifies the events' integrity by checking the CloudTrail file hashes and comparing with the signed manifest.

auditor_chloe: For RBAC I also want a short table: principal, previous role, new role, timestamp, commit sha, and whether the change was reviewed. That's helpful for control mapping.

alex_ops: Got it — I'll assemble that as rbac-change-table.csv. Quick heads up on redaction: some audit entries contain user emails/PII. We'll provide a redacted and an unredacted copy to the auditor under NDA. Redaction process will be documented in the manifest.

maya_oncall: One more thing: the incident root cause is tied to a CI job that temporarily granted elevated k8s edit perms via a service account. I captured the CI job run id and attached the job log to the export. I'll flag the exact PR number in the manifest.

samir_security: Sounds good. Action items summarized: Alex: CloudTrail/KMS export, sha256 + gpg sigs, presigned S3 links. Maya: RBAC diffs, k8s audit slice, CI job logs. Samir: produce chain-of-custody manifest & verification script, and a control-mapping doc that maps artifacts to SOC2 control IDs. Auditor: we'll message when presigned links are ready.

auditor_chloe: Thanks — please ping me once uploads are complete. If you can include a short narrated timeline (bullet points) linking action -> effect that would speed review. :+1:
